method: Regression standardisation with a linear outcome model: with A x W interactions, and with an aliased covariate (lm: NA coefficient, estimable predictions)
reference: stats::lm + standardisation as stdReg::stdGlm (gaussian); aliased column as lm (dqrdc2, NA coefficient; R 4.3.3 predict.lm does not warn because the counterfactual rows are estimable)
call: lm(yc ~ x1 + x2 + a + a:x1 + a:x2); lm(yc ~ x1 + x2 + x1dup + a)
